image_prompt.text: The central fire pit ringed with rough gray stones and stacked logs, sitting as the camp's visual anchor and readable from anywhere in the clearing
Worn dirt tracks threading between the fire pit, the two tents and the supply crates so a player walking the camp has an obvious grain to follow
The open ground immediately around the fire pit, ringed with felled-log seating sized for a group to gather at
A composed view of the camp from the track entrance, framing the tents, firelight and crates in brown timber and gray stone against natural medieval-rustic tones
Rough-hewn wooden fence posts marking the camp boundary, closing the clearing off as the limit of the buildable area
Two simple canvas-style tents in tan and dark cloth, one larger main tent and one smaller tent pitched beside it
A few rough wooden supply crates in brown timber, stacked around the camp as primitive storage

notes: Classified None (no genre): the prompt describes a place and its dressing, not a game type. 'Primitive survival campsite' reads as a style descriptor — there is no threat, no resource loop, and no escape or chase — so it was not routed to Survival.
Stage B: there is a space and the prompt says a player character walks through it, so no SET.
All five axes are left at their defaults and the prompt confirms rather than contradicts them: exterior, ground-level single surface, one camp, dressed geometry, grounded movement. Routes P0.

Preset Explorable Place taken with its shape default intact; social-hub and boundary-edge added on top for the log seating ring around the fire pit and the wooden fence posts, both of which the prompt asked for directly.

Stated footprint of roughly 30x30 studs and the palette (brown wood, gray fire-pit stone, tan and dark tents) have no field of their own; the palette is carried in the option text and the footprint is recorded here.

would have asked: Sounds like an explorable place rather than a game mode — a rustic camp clearing you walk through, with the stone fire pit as the thing you orient off, worn tracks between the tents and crates, log seating around the fire, and the fence posts closing the boundary. Want that, or would you rather build it up piece by piece?

would have asked: do players go inside the two tents, or are they closed props? Treated as closed props, which keeps this on the proven P0 route; enterable interiors would add a separate interior pass that is not ready yet.
would have asked: are the supply crates lootable pickups or set dressing? Built as dressing, so no collectible pickups were placed.
would have asked: anything else you want in the camp?
